t: Nimax Theatres is a group of West End theatres, owned and run by Nica Burns and Max Weitzenhoffer. Burns is a London theatre producer who co-owns the group with her business partner. It comprises six theatres: the Palace, Lyric, Apollo, Garrick, Vaudeville and Duchess. Burns also owns @sohoplace, which opened in 2022 and is operated by Nimax. Weitzenhoffer is an American theatre producer based in Oklahoma, known for his productions and philanthropy, and was inducted into the Oklahoma Hall of Fame in 1994.
